verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is one community comment saying Windows 10 ships 'Ubuntu userland support (WSL)'. That points to a built-in Windows capability for running a Linux environment, but no first-party documentation in the pack covers it, and its depth (full terminal, tooling compatibility) is unshown. Missing for 10: first-party WSL documentation, evidence of a full Linux terminal and distro environment, evidence of dev-tooling integration and file/network interop, and hands-on corroboration of how well it works.
